At 10.20 a.m. 2-9-40, a telephone message was
received from the Sung Foong (仁豐) Rice Shop, 323
Brenan road, reporting that the proprietor Ching Ping
Zung (金本行), 44, Shanghai, had been kidnapped.
Enquiries made by D.S. Weeks, D.S.I.Chu, C.D.S.
275 and U.D.C.328 revealed that, at 9 a.m. 2-9-40,
Ching Ping Zung left his shop at 323 Brenan Road and
proceeded to his main shop at 506 Brenan Road
( Chinese Number.).
At about 10 a.m. he left 506 Brenan Road and
walked south along Brenan road towards Edinburgh Rd.
with the intention of proceeding to the Ching Lee Kok
(清蓮閣) Tea Shop, Foochow road, where the rice shop
masters meet and hold a market. The visit to the main
shop and the Tea shop is a daily occurrence and is
always done at the same time.
When he had reached a point about 70 yards south
of 506 Brenan road, he was stopped by six male Chinese
who were standing beside a stationary Johnson hire
car, Lic. No. unknown, and forced into the car, which
then drove off towards Edinburgh road and disappeared.
This was witnessed by one named Chu Tsung Ching
(周順金), food-shop master, 470 Brenan road, who
immediately went to 323 Brenan road and told the
kidnapped man's wife Ching Kyi Sz (金記氏) what he
had seen.
When detectives arrived at 506 Brenan Road to
continue enquiries, they were informed by one of the
shop-assistants, that a male Chinese had just tele-
phoned and told him to inform Ching's wife that he
(Ching) was safe in the country. He also said that
the wife must not inform the police.

2

1940年9月2日上午10时20分，接到来自勃伦路323号仁豐（Sung Foong）米店的电话报告，称店主金本行（Ching Ping Zung），44岁，上海人，遭绑架。
经警司威克斯（D.S. Weeks）、华籍警司朱（D.S.I. Chu）、华籍侦探长275号及华籍侦探328号调查查明，1940年9月2日上午9时，金本行离开其位于勃伦路323号的店铺，前往其位于勃伦路506号（中文门牌）的总店。
上午10时许，他离开勃伦路506号，沿勃伦路向南朝爱丁堡路方向步行，打算前往福州路的清蓮閣（Ching Lee Kok）茶楼，那里是米店老板聚会和进行市场交易的地方。前往总店和茶楼是其日常惯例，且总是在同一时间进行。
当他走到勃伦路506号以南约70码处时，被六名站在停放的约翰逊租赁汽车旁的中国男子拦下，并被强行塞入车内，该车随后向爱丁堡路方向驶去并消失。
这一幕被勃伦路470号食品店老板周順金（Chu Tsung Ching）目击，他立即前往勃伦路323号，将所见告知被绑架者的妻子金記氏（Ching Kyi Sz）。
当侦探抵达勃伦路506号继续调查时，一名店员告知他们，刚才有一名中国男子打来电话，让他通知金的妻子，他（金）在乡下很安全。他还说，妻子不得报警。

Enquiries were made in the vicinity, but no other
person could be located, who would admit having wit-
nessed the happening.

At 11.20 a.m., a message was received from the
Reserve Unit reporting that at 11.15 a.m. R.U.C. 35 whilst
on search party of Changping road, had found a Johnson car
No. 18432 abandoned on dirt road near Changping road.

Detective proceeded to the scene and made an exam-
ination of the car, finding a Johnson chauffeur's uniform
jacket in the front seat.

Enquiries in the neighbourhood failed to locate any
person who had seen the car being abandoned.

At 11.40 a.m., a Johnson chauffeur named Yuen Tsz
Dsing (袁志成); S.M.C. Permit No. 7223, came to the
station and reported that his car No. 18432 had been
commandeered by a gang of male Chinese. He states:-

At 8.45 a.m., a telephone message was received at
the sub-station at Kiaochoow-Yu Yuen roads corner, request-
ing that a car be sent to Ave. Haig near Ave. Jeffre.

When he arrived there, the car was met by three
male Chinese, who ordered him to drive to the rear of
Jessfield Park.

On reaching St. John's University, he was told to
stop beside two male Chinese who were standing on the
roadway.

He was ordered to alight and taken off his uniform

在附近进行了查询，但未找到其他承认目击此事的人。

上午11时20分，接到后备队报告，称上午11时15分，后备队华籍警员35号在昌平路搜查期间，在昌平路附近的土路上发现一辆被遗弃的约翰逊汽车，车牌号18432。

侦探赶赴现场并对车辆进行检查，在前排座位发现一件约翰逊 chauffeur（司机）制服上衣。

在周边查询未能找到任何目睹车辆被遗弃的人。

上午11时40分，一名名为袁志成（Yuen Tsz Dsing）的约翰逊司机，工部局许可证号7223，来到警局报告，称其车牌号为18432的汽车被一伙中国男子强征。他陈述如下：

上午8时45分，胶州路与愚园路转角分局接到电话，要求派车前往海格路靠近杰弗里斯路（Ave. Jeffre）处。

当他到达那里时，三名中国男子拦住汽车，命令他开车至兆丰公园（Jessfield Park）后方。

到达圣约翰大学时，有人让他停在路边两名站立的中国男子旁边。

他被命令下车，并被脱去制服上

jacket and handed it over to one of the gang.
One of the original passengers then escorted him
into a car and kept guard over him, whilst the
other four men drove off in the car.
Shortly after 11 a.m., one of the men returned to the
lane and told him that he was to report to his guard
house. He was paid the sum of $15.00 for the fare and
also given a $10.00 note as "baksheesh". During the whole
time, he did not see any of the men carrying arms. In
view of the above, it is therefore most probable that
this car was the one used in this kidnapping.
The Finger Print Bureau was informed and attended.
This report will be included to the next diary.
Chin Kyi Ss was questioned whether her husband had
any political affiliations either with the Nanking or
Chungkiang regimes, or whether he had recently received
any threatening letters.
She stated that her husband had no outside interests
only being concerned with his business. He had been
informed her of having received any letters of a threaten-
ing nature.
Ching Kyi Ss had been informed to immediately report
to the Station when she receives any communication from
the kidnappers.

1940年9月2日。

衣，并交给团伙中的一人。
最初的一名乘客随后将他押入另一辆车并看守他，而另外四人则驾车离去。
上午11点后不久，其中一人回到弄堂，告诉他可以向岗亭报告。他获得了15.00美元的车费，并额外得到一张10.00美元的钞票作为“小费”。在整个过程中，他未看见任何人携带武器。鉴于上述情况，这辆车极有可能是用于此次绑架的车辆。
已通知指纹局并派人到场。
本报告将列入下一份日记。
对金記氏（Chin Kyi Ss）进行了讯问，询问其丈夫是否与南京或重庆政权有任何政治联系，或者最近是否收到过任何恐吓信。
她表示，其丈夫除生意外无其他外界事务。她并未被告知收到过任何具有恐吓性质的信件。（注：原文此处逻辑似有矛盾或笔误，照实翻译）
已告知金記氏，一旦收到绑匪的任何联络，须立即向警局报告。

The nearer policemen to the scene were three S.C.G.P.
Bureau constables on duty at Brenan - Edinburgh roads cor-
ner, about 150 yards away. Detectives were informed by
Insp. Foo of the Brenan Road Sub-Station, that these men
had been questioned, and had reported that they did not
see the kidnappings

Detectives are continuing inquiries in an endeavour
to secure information regarding this gang and the where-
abouts of the Kidnappers now.

D.S. 252.

距离案发现场最近的警察是三名在勃伦路与爱丁堡路转角执勤的上海特别市警察局（S.C.G.P.）巡捕，距离约150码。勃伦路分局的傅督察（Insp. Foo）告知侦探，这些人已接受问询，并报告说他们没有看到绑架过程。

侦探正在继续调查，以获取有关该团伙及绑匪目前下落的信息。

华籍警司 252号。
